claude.sample_unit: runs (28 synthetic vignettes x 4 conditions x 2 repeats)

links.outcome: Effect of persona/system prompt variation on LLM outputs and contraindication violations
links.effect: High time-pressure prompts reduced tests_count (β=-1.05) and entropy (β=-0.246); contraindication/sequence violations occurred only in High×LEAN (8/56, 14.3%), all in trap cases.
links.quote: Prompt-aware red-teaming using targeted trap cases may reveal concentrated failure modes that are missed by aggregate accuracy metrics.

links.outcome: Safety-critical sequencing and contraindication violations in simulated ED cases under time-pressure/lean prompts
links.effect: Violations occurred only in High×LEAN condition (8/56, 14.3% overall); all in trap cases, high severity (mean 2.75/3).
links.quote: Contraindication/sequence violations occurred only in the High×LEAN condition (8/56, 14.3% overall); all violations occurred in trap cases and were high severity (mean 2.75/3).
